name: Mango Coconut Sticky Rice
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 2 cups uncooked sticky rice, rinsed well

steps: Bring coconut milk to a boil with pandan leaves. Add a little salt to taste.
Stir in the coconut water. Stir in the sticky rice, and simmer about 15 minutes over low heat.
Stir in the mango, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add sugar and stir until the sugar has dissolved. Add the coconut meat.

culture.text: Glutinous rice is a type of rice grown mainly in Southeast Asia and the northeastern regions of South Asia, which has opaque grains and very low amylose content and is especially sticky when cooked. It is widely consumed across Asia.
